nodes.label: Favicon (adaptive Codel symbol)
nodes.description: Codel symbol only (viewBox 303.32x117.31): the slanted interlocking 'co' monogram as one path with class 'm'. An inline <style> fills it charcoal #101411 by default and switches it to lime #c4f527 under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark).
nodes.rationale: One file serves both browser themes: ink mark on light tab bars, lime mark on dark tab bars, so the favicon stays visible without shipping two icons. The path data is byte-identical to the brand symbol files, so the mark is not redrawn.
